nom: Hero Cosmetics Rescue Balm +Red Correct Post-Blemish Recovery Cream

avis.texte: The old formula worked wonders to reduce redness. The new formula gives a bad tan, it doesnt blend, and it does NOT reduce redness in any way. I refuse to buy this product anymore. Sad

avis.titre: NEW FORMULA Rescue Balm Color Correcting Green Cream
avis.texte: I don't hate the new formula, but I didn't like the old formula to begin with. It works for me, but I understand why other customers are disappointed. I found the old formula too orange and matte for my liking, but it did have more coverage. I wanted the old formula to be less matte, and more sheer, which the new one is, but at the expense of less coverage. Again, I get why everyone is disappointed, but this formula works better for me personally. Good new formula because less matte; bad because less coverage and color correcting. Try it out for yourself and see how you like it on an individual basis.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again
avis.texte: I loved the original formula. It worked amazingly. I could wear it without makeup when I didn't want to bother with putting on makeup.It looked natural. The new formula I could not leave it on without makeup. It does not blend into your skin and did not dull the redness on my face. Now I have to find another brand that works as great as the original formula. Sadly I have not been able to find one!

This new formula sucks. I used to use this in place of foundation and it was perfect. The new formula doesnt have the same cover and is oily and sticky almost. The old formula actually blended great with my skin. Seems like everyone thinks the same.
they changed the formula unfortunately. the last bottle I bought was liquidy and worthless. hopefully they go back to the original formula and remarket it.

avis.titre: What happened to the old formula?
avis.texte: I bought this in I think late 2024 and it was awesome - a perfect product for me, with light/fair, redness-prone skin. I was able to use it without having to layer on other complexion cosmetics over it for a natural look, and I loved that it provided the option for focused blemish coverage without being comedogenic and irritating like so many other cosmetics are for sensitive skin like mine. Flash forward to late 2025, when I bought a tube to replace my most recent one, and there's a totally new formula with a different visual texture, lower pigmenation/opacity, stickiness, and a warmer/orangier hue. What happened?! I looked at the package and it seems Hero maybe got sold, but whoever bought it has gutted this product and replaced it with a cheap, very poor imitation. Bring back the old formula!!!! I won't be buying it again unless I hear that it has changed back from this awful new formulation.
This was my die hard go-to product. So disappointing they changed the formula! There is little to NO redness coverate anymore

I should have listed to the other reviews. The new formula is NOTHING like the old PERFECT one! Why did they try to fix what was not broken? I hope the brand is actually seeing these reviews. Please please please bring back the old formula!

I thought I was going crazy, idk what they did to this formula but it is completely different! Its thinner, doesnt blend in, and pilles up. Such a disappointment, this was my holy grail for my redness!
I dont know why this profuct had to change its formula … it was so good that I didnt need foundation it acted as one . I miss the old formula . Please bring it back!

The old formula of this product was absolutely lifesaving for my redness prone skin - I used it every single day for years. The new formula is absolute garbage and has zero redness coverage at all, it just makes my skin look orange. I'm crushed that I no longer have my go-to product.
I loved this product, but they ruined it. The new formula is too yellow in color. Will not be buying again. Hate it.
I used the old formula daily which allowed me to skip foundation. The new formula is too greasy and orange.

I have used this for years the okd forumal actually covered up my red angry pimples. This new formula doesnt cover uo the redness at all. If anything it makes the big red angry pimple look even worse and more red. I am so disappointed.

I have purchased and repurchased this cream multiple times. I have tried other creams, and they either have a weird texture or smell odd. This is my go-to cream and layers great under my SPF and foundation.

I love the new formula because its much more hydrating than the old formula. They're completely different, the old and new, and Hero could get away with making both - a matte finish and a hydrating finish. But I use it more as a 2 in one, as a moisturizer that also creates a good base for my makeup while reducing redness and it has great ingredients for any active breakouts. Im definitely a fan of the new formula!
used the old formula daily, was obsessed with it. new formula? wont be buying again
I hope they do not discontinue this product, it's the best for reducing the red that is all over my cheeks and forehead.
Not sure how other reviews say it show a brown tint? There is no brown tint! applies on well. does help with post blemish redness with consistency!

This used to be my ride or die product but they reformulated it some time in the past year & its HORRIBLE now. Doesnt cover the redness, its sticky, & smells awful. Hopefully i can find something new for my redness issues.
The old formula was the best product ever. I cant find anything like it. This new formula sucks so bad.

this was an everyday staple for me but this new formula is trash! it has no coverage and blending it out is an orange nightmare. guess i have to find a new product. i hope they bring back the old formula!

This was an everyday staple for me. Stocked up and had to get a refund. New formula has a terrible texture and no coverage. Dont buy it unless they being back the old one completely. Ill be searching for a new product.

avis.titre: pls bring back the old formula < 3
avis.texte: new formula is terrible!! i thought maybe i had gotten a defective one until i saw all the reviews here. this was an incredible product and now it's genuinely unusable. straight to the trash. hero cosmetics pls change the formula back!!
This product made me feel WORSE about my acne. It doesn't cover anything. It is grainy, patchy, orange, and does nothing helpful

avis.titre: Unusable now BRING BACK OLD FORMULA PLZ
avis.texte: This new formula is one hundred percent unusable. It doesnt cover my redness or acne at all and it makes me so sad because I loved this in lieu of foundation to give my skin a break. Really hoping they fix this asap because until then this is a waste of money and i refuse to buy it.
New formula is just awful and does absolutely nothing besides make me oily. I have been begging for the old formula back for months.

Ive been using this stuff daily for years. The new formula is absolute garbage and doesnt cover anything. im returning it and needing to find a different product. Why change something thats not broken?

avis.titre: Bring back the old formula. No shame in it!
avis.texte: I used the old product almost everyday. It was perfect for work, running errands, and casual outings. This new formula is an entirely new product. It had its uses, but they are very different from the original. I wish they would bring back the old formula, and remarket this compound as a new product. I suggest as a color-correcting primer. However, I will say that I'm noticing more breakouts since the formula change, so I'm not sure I would use it. Please bring back the old formula!!

Only giving it a bad review in hopes it gets sone sort of attention. Clearly, thr new formula isnt working. I bought a new one and hadnt relized it was a new formula! Right away as i applied it, i knew something was wrong. This was the one AFFORDABLE product that truly worked. So sad for us rosacea girlies. :(((((

I used this product as my base daily for years. It corrected redness and evened skintone without looking heavy or causing breakouts. It was truly my holy grail cc cream. The new formula is a disappointment. It doesnt dry well, coverage is poor so you have to use twice as much product to get the same redness reduction. While it doesn't break me out, it leaves my face feeling significantly more oily than the old formula did. Hero lost a loyal customer with this formulation change.
I had been using this corrector for years and loved how pigmented and effective it was at covering redness. They must have updated the formula becaue it does not cover my redness like it once did.
This covered up my redness very well. The texture is soft on my skin. Didn't have any reactions. I use it as a foundation. My only complaint is that the bottle is smaller than I expected.
The photos above are exactly correct. The old formula was aboslutely perfect 5 stars —cool with just the right amount of coverage. The new formula is so yellow! It covered nothing!
If you're looking for a warm fake tan than this is the product for you! I am pale with a lot if redness and this is straight orange on me.
the old formula was my favorite product ever. this new one is horrible; translucent, orange, and sticky with no red correct. bring back the OG!

Not sure why there's negative review. I love this product, it is a great every day pick me up for my zoom meetings and running errands. Reduces redness and gives the skin a little boost. It isn't a foundation so wont solve all your coverage issues as expected.

avis.titre: PLEASE BRING BACK THE OLD FORMULA
avis.texte: This product used to be AMAZING. Recently, the formula was changed, and now it's not even worth the money. I used to love and rely on this product to cover my redness and acne. The new formula barely covers my redness and acne and leaves my skin sticky. It also transfers onto everything because it never fully dries. PLEASE bring back the old formula!

I DID use this as a quick makeup/ red coverage before work every single day. it was my holy grail product, couldn't live without it. I have LITERALLY purchased one of these about every 2 weeks for the last year..... UNTIL the formula changed. I have not repurchase since. Ew. So sad.

I haven't tried the old formula of this so I can't compare this version vs the old formula. All I can say is that it works much better than Bubble's new redness corrector- this one is better coverage even if I'm slightly red and gives me good color to my winter-translucent-pale complexion as well as a smoother application and doesn't pill.

avis.titre: Would buy it again! But it matters what your skin tone is!
avis.texte: Not sure what the old formula was like but I feel like this works for me!! I put the formula on one cheek and one without it, and I definitely noticed a difference. I have a medium tan complexion so the color changing formula may match my skin more.

avis.titre: Bring back the old formula, PLEASE!!!
avis.texte: I'd never relied on a "holy grail" product until I discovered this—unfortunately, the brand destroyed the product with the reformulation. The day they bring the OG formula back, I will be first in line, but for now I'm on the hunt to find an alternative.

I'm so sad. The new formula is absolute garbage. I have rosacea and the old formula was smooth, provided good coverage with zero effort… I have never been devastated about a beauty product changing before. I'm a very lazy, low maintenance skin care kinda gal, and this truly was my holy grail.
The old formula was the best especially for my fair skin. The new formula is so orange on me and feels sticky all day. Absolutely hate it and will need to find a new product.

avis.titre: Why would you ruin a perfect product?
avis.texte: The reformulation is a nightmare. I am shocked at how bad they dropped the ball here. Insane. After using for years, i wont again until the old formula returns.
Very oily and doesn't absorb. It takes a lot of product to cover the redness. Plus, I'm pale, so it wasn't the best color match. Returned it!

I used to love this product because it did cover the redness pretty well especially when I get break outs. The new formula doesn't work at all. The old fomula was more of a paste and the new one almost feels too watered down. Please bring the old formula back. 😩

Do not buy the new formula. It's a weird consistently, greasy, and doesn't not red correct at all. Supposedly Hero is working to fix but who knows. The OG was a Holy Grail for my acne prone sensitive skin. I loved it for my more clear days that I didn't want to wear foundation and used it as a primer. I hope it returns to how it was.

avis.titre: why on earth did you change to a new worse formula
avis.texte: I am truly puzzled why hero would mess up a good thing. the new forumal doesn't do anything at all.

If you have acne problems, use the "acne-safe" app. My loves, it is the onlyyyy thing that has saved me. I realized after using this app that this product was causing me to have acne, even though it has "clean ingredients". Please remove or find acne safe replacements for: Butyrospermum Parkii Shea Butter, Spirulina, & Beeswax. These ingredients are why I can no longer use this product. I found it to be amazing otherwise- the way it adjusted to my skin tone was especially wonderful. Oh- I guess I also didnt like how shiny it would make my face. It would eventually dry if I used a very small amount, but would typically make my skin very shiny (& I do not like to use powder bc i have not found one that's non-pore clogging). I could look past this issue however if the product was non-comedogenic.
I never had a holy grail product until the old formula of this product. It was soothing and corrected my redness like nothing else I have ever used. Please please please bring it back

Hero, PLEASE bring back the old formula the new formula is a joke. it has no coverage and makes my skin look so greasy please bring back old formula. i know im not the first to complain about this and i wont be the last.

im so happy to see all the reviews agreeing on how awful the new formula is. this was my magic cream, my ride or die cream, i would need just this as my only step & have the most flawless skin without having to put on anything else. i came to write this review to express my frustration on how much i really hate this new formula! not only is there absolutely like no green to the cream anymore, i look more red after applying, theres some kind of like exfoliation in the cream now & i think this new formula is breaking me out. im so upset because this cream was my savior skin secret & im afraid i have to savor the last of what i have from the old formula. i work at ulta & i would recommend this product to everyone but i will no longer be doing that because this new formula is atrocious. please seriously bring back the old formula, listen to your customers because sounds like we were all long time purchasers. i have used this product for years & im so so so sad

As others have said the new formula is completely different I'm so disappointed. I immediately noticed the difference out of the tube, it's sticky and greasy and has no coverage. The old formula was my everyday go to and now I need to find a new product.

avis.titre: Please bring back my moisturizer, primer and makeup.
avis.texte: The old formula was a holy grail product. Will have to go back to my previous makeup. The Milky Cleanser is gone too. This was also a HG one. Is this company going out of business?
the new formula is so greasy and doesnt cover the same :/ pleaseeee please bring back the old formula!
This product is great! To help blend, lightly tap the edges of the area where it was applied

avis.titre: Ruined this product by changing the formula
avis.texte: Used to love the old version and recommended to so many of my friends. It was my go to primer/foundation and it worked really well with my 74 yr old facial redness for a few years. So Why ? Why ? Why ? Did they have to go and change the formula assuming that nobody would notice ? Apparently I am not the only one who's disgusted with the change based on all of the other negativity reviews on here. Now I need to find a different brand that works for me. Stupid move on whoever's idea it was to change the formula.
I have fair skin and this didn't cancel out much of my redness, instead it looked yellow. The one thing I liked was the texture/ consistency.

avis.titre: please bring back the original formula!
avis.texte: this product used to be a staple in my everyday routine. it was such a smooth formula that truly did help with redness and blemishes. but the new formula has a completely different texture, it doesnt blend into your skin the same, and i feel like the coverage just doesnt compare. i wish i had stocked up on the old one before they changed :((

I truly hope Hero Cosmetics brings back the original formula after all the negative reviews regarding their new formulation. The new product is nothing like the old one, which I used every single day as a substitute for foundation. My local stores are sold out of the old formula, and after trying the new formulation, I will not be purchasing it again. I understand that ingredients may not be as readily available, or may be more expensive d/t tariffs, but the company will lose a lot more money overall w/ no longer having a market for this product. I am actually here on Ulta's website looking for a replacement for this product and felt the need to write a review while here.

avis.titre: Bring the old formula back PLEASEE
avis.texte: i still have my old one and i recently just bought the new one, i noticed they had change the formula and i was excited to see how the one would give.. i been using the old formula for years!! & it had helped with my redness even with my acne, i hate the new formula it's give me a oily affect and made me break out im so disappointed because the old formula was really working wonders so now i gotta look for another redness cream that works out for me.

I've been using this color correct for a couple years and it was great...until they changed the formulation. It provides very little coverage/color correction now and has a greasy finish. Unfortunately, I didn't open the new tube until after the return period so I'm stuck with very worthless product!

Not long lasting and transfers a lot. I wish it was longer lasting on the face. Otherwise it does very well at covering up and neutralizing redness and acne. It does leave an oily residue on my face and can break me out though. :/

The old formula was a cult classic favorite for this red-faced gal. The new formula is greasy and doesn't have any coverage. I won't be purchasing it again! I recommend everyone send a note using the Contact Us form on Hero's website. Maybe we can get them to bring it back?
I loved this so much, until it broke me out in hives. DO NOT get this if you have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Did I miss a change with this product?
avis.texte: Wondering about the rescue balm with red correct formula changes. I have been a avid user of this product and can't rave enough about it. It had become increasingly hard to find in my local stores, so I placed and online order for several tubes(through Ulta). The product I received was not ole faithful, the texture was different(more like a silky primer instead of creamy), and the coverage was much less. The new tubes, while still showing the same volume was in it, was slightly smaller as I compared to the many older tubes I have around. Is this a formula, change? If so, it makes me sad! The older product was far superior.

I have used this ever day for probably about 4 or so years. I have acne prone skin. The old formula soothed my blemishes while also adding a little bit of coverage and color correcting the redness. The result was a nice moisturized glow. This new formula is completely different and I hate it :-(. It does not color correct my redness, and offers no blemish coverage either. It's almost like there is less encapsulated pigments in this formula. To make it worse, this new formula makes my already oily skin SO shiny. I was a die hard fan for so long and now I can't use this product anymore since it does absolutely nothing for my skin.

PLEASE bring back the original formula. I was so disappointed when I got a new tube. I used it and it seemed gritty and the color is basically yellow. It's beyond usable for me. This was my all time favorite product 😩

I loved this product, searched long and hard for redness correcting, found this and fell in love. Just bought the "new" formula and will be returning as soon as I can. It's not a new formula, it's a different product and its greasy, doesn't blend. No

I bought a new tube and had no idea they have changed it so drastically. It's now runny, provides zero redness reduction and feels so oily on my skin. It's so drastically different I was shocked. They even slightly changed the wording on the tube but not enough to let buyers know they changed all things that were good about it! Wish I could return it but I've already tossed the box. Such a waste and terrible change to such a great product for those with rosacea or redness. Disappointing!

The original formula has been my every day go to for YEARS! I mean I buy multiple at a time to make sure I don't run out. Well, I ran out and this new formula is HORRIBLE. It covers nothing, actually makes me more red! Bring back the old please 😩😩
The original formal worked so well! The new formula does nothing for my skin. I'm really hoping they'll change it back.

I have absolutely loved this product for years! It was one of the only products that gave great coverage for acne scars without making my sensitive skin breakout. However, this new formula is greasy, barely color corrects, and is incredibly thin. Bring back the old formula!!
I have been using this product for years! It was my every day product and they changed the formula and i was highly disappointed. Will have to find a new product.
Please bring back the old formula. This new one turns my skin orange immediately. I loved this product for years!! What happened with this new formula??

This was my base for my makeup since it came out. It blended beautifuly and covered all my redness perfectly. This new formula is trashy and doesnt cover ANYTHING. Just makes me look like a greaseball with redness. So dissapointed in Hero for changing this formula to something awful. Bring back the old formula!! Will be returning the new ones.

I have recommended this product for years on rosacea forums and it is my holy grail...however, this new formula is terrible! It is thinner and turns brown before it ever hits my face. It breaks me out also and the old formula did not. I am SO disappointed!

This was my daily product since it came out but the new formula is the complete opposite of what it was. I would apply spf, then this product and I would be ready to go out the door. All my redness and red spots would be covered just enough without looking or feeling like foundation. Now it feels like I am rubbing lip gloss all over my face and the tint does not show up. So it's just a clear, greasy mess. Sad to say I will have to look for an alternative product.

avis.titre: The new formula has RUINED the product
avis.texte: I have loyally used this product for the past 3 years. I loved it, it was a staple in my routine. Sadly I have to retire it now, because it makes my face extremely sticky and does not blend well at all. It was perfect before. Now, it is ruined and I'm very upset.
Old formula was amazing!!! New formula doesnt last as long and has a slighty orange tint once blended in

I was looking for a redness corrector for the bridge of my nose and around my nostrils. This one was disappointing. Felt like straight up chapstick on my skin and when i started to blend, it disappeared losing its purpose. Nice concept but this is a miss. Back to searching

avis.titre: I LOVED this product... BEFORE they changed the formula :(
avis.texte: So disappointed when I went to repurchase my 4th empty of this product it was labeled "new formula"... NEW with NO coverage and for pale girls you will be orange, no more light green/olive tint to mask redness. OILY, GRAINY and never dries down :(
The new formula is very watered down and does not have the color correcting effect as the prevjos formula. This was my holy grail and I will not be purchaisng it no lonver.

avis.titre: So Disappointed in the New Formula
avis.texte: Used to love this product and would apply it daily, it was a holy grail for calming my redness and giving me a natural look. But since they changed the formula, it's been a huge letdown. It now feels greasy on my skin, doesn't neutralize redness the way it used to, and leaves behind an odd yellow-orange tint. I also noticed small white specks that weren't in the previous version, which makes application look uneven and patchy. Please bring back the original formula—this new one just doesn't work the same, and I sadly won't be repurchasing unless they change it back.
Why change a good thing? The new formula doesn't even correct redness. It also leaves a tacky feeling in your face. So disappointed

The new formula takes a former holy grail product and completely ruins each and every one of its good qualities. The old formula was thin, easy to blend, and highly pigmented; it would only oxidize very slightly when drying, which on my skin tone resulted in a very natural coverage for blemishes. It was better for me than the straight green concealers due to its paint-like consistency and lighter color. I loved being able to use it as a standalone replacement for foundation/concealer on acne and red marks, to give my skin a break from having to put on full makeup. Plenty of days I would just dab on some of the old formula and my skin would look clear all day, but could also add makeup on top of it if I wanted and still benefit from the color correction on my acne underneath. The new formula has the consistency of Neosporin, with an inexplicable grainy texture in the mix. It is sticky and sheer with barely any pigment, so there's almost no actual color correction for red spots. It is also nigh-unblendable and never fully dries. What it DOES do is oxidize into a dark orange immediately upon spreading. So far from having a high-coverage, color correcting alternative to concealer, you get to have sheer, wet/shiny, sticky, orange spots on your face, which will immediately wipe off if touched at all. Plain green concealer has never worked for me, and I loved this product bc it offered both color correction and skin-healing benefits with an extremely natural finish. Now I've got to

I loved this stuff! As someone with rosacea I have a hard time finding something that actually helps with my redness. This time I got it though I noticed the box said "new formula". Not improved. The new version is less green and turns yellow right away. Im super bummed. Not a good product anymore.

I loved the old formula but recently they changed it. It feels greasy and not as much pigment pay off as the last formula. The texture is completely different and my face looks really orange. I really wish they didn't change the formula because now i want to return it. I dont know if it will break me out or not. There's no information on the new formula. Just really upset.

I have been buying this product for years and loved it. Unfortunately, this last time I purchased, I noticed it was advertising a 'new formula'. Well, thats code for no longer offers coverage, is oily and all around useless. I am so bummed because this used to be my go-to

I have rosacea and acne and have struggled with confidence my whole life. For nearly 10 years i refused to leave the house without makeup on because i was so embarassed. I've embraced my skin the last few years, but found this and decided to give it a try. Yall, this product made me feel like i was seeing what i look like without red skin for the first time ever! I walked out of the bathroom after trying it out and my husband told me i was glowing! However, after reading other reviews about the pigment, im realizing maybe it works so well for me because it's summer and i currently have a tan. I plan on continuing to use it regularly for now, but we'll see if its still a match for me in a few months when my tan fades, as im naturally very fair skinned. But for now, i can finally enjoy the heat of summer without piling makeup on for every event and dealing with sweat and touch-ups because my skin finally looks NORMAL without a full face of foundation!! I'm so excited.
Didnt find it covered redness , feels oily and worse -it made me break out and I NEVER break out nor do I have sensitive skin!!! Returning
this blends out as straight up orange on me. it reminds me of those "color changing" foundations that are actually just made with encapsulated pigments.

Lost the receipt and so sad that i did, i hated this. I'm extremely pale with a lot of redness and this made me look orange and it felt really heavy on my skin. Made my makeup peel. So disappointed. Do not recommend.

Lost the receipt and so sad that i did, i hated this. I'm extremely pale with a lot of redness and this made me look orange and it felt really heavy on my skin. Made my makeup peel. So disappointed. Do not recommend.

I have a pretty fair skinton, with pink undertones and oddly enough sometimes I use this as foundation. It gives you a clear and smoother looking skin and feels weightless. Once you put the product on yohr face irs green but once you rub it into your skin it turns into your skin tone and I would say it does cover up redness pretty nicely, not all the way put like 80% covers red spots (minor pimples, and such) it also last up to 8 hours and is buildable/wearable with makeup products such as concealer.

I purchased this, however I have rosacea it did not assist in helping color correct my skin at all. Waste of my money wish I had been able to find the receipt so I could take it back. Empty promises just like most color correcting cosmetics.
Attn pale people - this will not work for you. I should have read the reviews. It has potential and will be beautiful if you are light to medium toned.
This goes on green and adapts to your perfect skin color to cover up redness and soothe. I absolutely love it.

I have rosacea and this is a godsend. This blends into the skin so seamlessly. Sometimes color correctors will make my skin look dry or the pigment will sit in my huge pores and I hate that. Perfect to spot treat just my cheeks. I like that this is skin care rather than makeup, because I have acne prone skin so I try my best to keep my skin care minimal. 10/10 I recommend

This rescue balm by Hero works great on my periodic rosacea. It blends in well and matches my skin perfectly. It's not heavy, but covers well, making it a great addition to my daily make up routine. This balms starts out green then turns skin toned. This works great under my concealer, making sure no redness peeks through. It's a good value too. A little goes a long way.

Its a good affordable color corrector, my only complaint is that if you use too much It can leave a yellowish/warm cast on your skin, especially if you are pale. I use a tone up sunscreen to prevent that afterwards.For the price, cant complain.
I like this product! Corrects redness and does its job. It does add a slight tint to fair complexion, so be wary of that. Does have a heavier feel on the skin, especially when compared with Cicapair

I am very fair-skinned and have a red, splotchy complexion. I was hoping this product would help reduce my need for concealer but unfortunately, it did not cover my redness much if at all. However, it did seem to smooth and mattify my skin so I may use it as a primer.

I really love this stuff as a spot correcter on red pimples instead of concealor. I do have fair skin and I will say it is hard to use for fair skin unfortuantly as it can look a bit orange. Its unfortuante because many people that suffer with skin redness are naturally fair. With a little practice and only applying sparingly I think it works great still.

I really love this stuff as a spot correcter on red pimples instead of concealor. I do have fair skin and I will say it is hard to use for fair skin unfortuantly as it can look a bit orange. Its unfortuante because many people that suffer with skin redness are naturally fair. With a little practice and only applying sparingly I think it works great still.

I was super hopeful for this based on images and reviews and I will say that the consistency and application of this product is nice, but omg it is not for the pale people. Even under my concealer/foundation (which is medium coverage) there was a visible orange tint to my skin making it look like I had a bad self-tanner on my face. I could see it *maybe* working for medium-to-dark skinned, warm undertone people, but it's definitely not for those who are closer to the "porcelain" or cool undertone categories.

I use this product everyday, either mixing it in with my skin tint for more color correction or by itself. It corrects all my redness from my rosacea and any breakouts. Couldn't recommend this product enough, its amazing.
